resources.string: Creates a VPN connection that routes no traffic. The session name you enter is what appears next to "Connected to" in system notifications and dialogs.
No confirmation window appeared. Make sure no other VPN is active, allow "background pop-up windows" for this app in system app settings, then tap Connect again.
Another VPN (%1$s) is set as Always-On VPN. Disable it in Settings > Network & Internet > VPN, then tap Connect again.
VPN configuration is restricted by a device policy on this device.
Failed to start VPN. Check logcat.
